note: Adapted from the original English description by Harris (1966) (new species, type locality Kisumu, Kenya); the original describes neither the alate nor the worker. Measurements are translated verbatim from the table of the original, in millimetres.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The major soldier has only 1 median marginal tooth on the inner margin of the left mandible, unlike A. wasmanni (2 very small marginal teeth at the middle of the left mandible); compared with A. latinotus the marginal tooth of the left mandible is reduced and the notch of the anterior margin of the pronotum is markedly deeper; A. cavithorax has a rounder head and A. periphrasis more strongly incurved mandibles. The minor soldier is larger than in A. periphrasis and proportionally longer-headed; compared with A. latinotus the mandibles are more curved, the posterior part of the head narrower, and the pronotum distinctly wider.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: head broadly oval, the posterior margin gently curved; labrum large, as long as wide, blunt at the tip; mandibles stout, straight at the base and then strongly curved towards the apex, each with 1 median marginal tooth, the right mandible with an additional short basal tooth; antennae 14—15-segmented, the number depending on whether the very short third segment is separated from the fourth. Pronotum with the anterior lobe small and pointed, a deep notch between the lobes; posterior margin slightly undulate. Minor soldier: head oval, narrower posteriorly; labrum large and pointed; mandibles slender, straight, incurved at the apex, the marginal tooth inconspicuous; antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 very short. Pronotum with the anterior lobe short and rounded, a rounded obtuse notch between the lobes; posterior margin nearly straight. Measurements (mm; table of the original, the mean in parentheses): head length including mandibles, major soldier 1.91—2.18 (1.99), minor soldier 1.54—1.72 (1.63); head length 1.18—1.41 (1.26), 0.86—1.00 (0.92); head width 1.09—1.25 (1.15), 0.86—0.91 (0.91); left mandible length 0.73—0.82 (0.78), 0.77—0.82 (0.79); pronotum width 0.82—0.95 (0.88), 0.68—0.77 (0.71); hind tibia length 1.00—1.14 (1.05), 0.91—0.95 (0.92).
